关闭 JIT：对典型 Web 请求收益有限，却额外占用内存、拖慢首次编译: Disable JIT: typical web requests gain little, while it costs memory and slows the first compile
写入后需重启对应 PHP 版本（停止再启动）才会生效——php-cgi 不会热加: Restart the matching PHP version (stop then start) to apply — php-cgi does not hot-reload php.ini.

开发期文件频繁变更，文件描述符缓存会导致改完不生效，建议关闭: Files change constantly in development; the open file cache would hide your edits, so turn it off
开发期直接把错误显示在页面上（生产应 Off）: Show errors right on the page during development (should be Off in production)
开发期访问日志写入量很大（尤其前端热更新），关掉能明显减少磁盘 IO: Access logs are heavy in development (especially with hot reload); disabling them cuts disk IO noticeably
开发模式开启断言（生产应为 -1）: Enable assertions in development mode (should be -1 in production)
开启字节码缓存：省掉每个请求重复编译 PHP 的开销，本地开发同样受益: Enable the bytecode cache: skips recompiling PHP on every request, which helps locally too
报告全部错误等级，提前暴露废弃与隐患写法: Report every error level to surface deprecations and risky code early
抬高单进程可打开文件数上限，配合上面的连接数（Windows 无此指令）: Raise the per-process descriptor limit to match the connection count above (no such directive on Windows)
按本机内存给的共享内存大小；不够时 opcache 会频繁重启缓存，命中率骤降: Shared memory sized to this machine's RAM; if too small opcache restarts often and the hit rate collapses
按本机内存给的单请求上限：太小会白屏（Allowed memory size e: Per-request memory ceiling sized to this machine; too small gives a blank page (Allowed memory size exhausted)
断言失败抛异常而不是静默警告: Throw on failed assertions instead of emitting a silent warning
未声明默认字符集时，响应头可能不带 charset，页面易出现乱码: Without a default charset the response header may omit it, which easily leads to garbled output
